notes:

motions.item_title: Decision Report, 210, 214 and 222 College Avenue East, Official Plan and Zoning By-law Amendments - 2026-230
motions.text: That the Official Plan application submitted by GSP Group Inc., on behalf of EM Guelph Developments Limited Partnership, to change the land use designation from “Low Density Residential” to “High Density Residential”, and to add a site specific policy to permit a maximum net density of 324 units per hectare, to permit the development of a 117 dwelling unit, purpose-built apartment building on the lands municipally known as 210, 214 and 222 College Avenue East, and legally described as Part of Lot 5, Concession 2, Division ‘G’ City of Guelph as in ROS157850, ROS524942, & ROS666478, be approved in accordance with Attachment-3 of the Infrastructure, Development and Environment report 2026-230, dated September 9, 2026. That the application from GSP Group Inc., on behalf of EM Guelph Developments Limited Partnership, for a Zoning By-law Amendment to change the current “Low Density Residential 1” (RL.1) Zone and (RL.1(H1)) Zone to a revised “Specialized High Density Residential 7” (RH.7-27(H)) Zone in Zoning By-law (2023)-20790, as amended, to permit the development of a 7-storey, 117 dwelling unit, purpose-built apartment building on the lands municipally known as 210, 214 and 222 College Avenue East, and legally described as Part of Lot 5, Concession 2, Division ‘G’ City of Guelph as in ROS157850, ROS524942, & ROS666478, be approved in accordance with Attachment-4 of the Infrastructure, Development and Environment report 2026-230, dated September 9, 2026. That in accordance with Section 34(17) of the Planning Act, City Council has determined that no further public notice is required related to the minor modifications to the proposed Zoning By-law Amendment affecting the lands municipally known as 210, 214 and 222 College Avenue East.

1. motions.item_title: Decision Meeting - 220 Arkell Road Proposed DPA and ZBA File OZS19-017 - 2026-433
